top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The presence of a spindle cell tumor with infiltrative growth pattern, positive for epithelial markers and mesenchymal marker, and negative for GCDFP, ER, and PR, along with the clinical presentation of a firm, mobile, non-tender lump and an ill-defined mass with irregular margins on mammography, strongly supports this diagnosis.

Although the tumor shows mixed epithelial and mesenchymal components, the absence of squamous differentiation and the clinical presentation are not as strongly supportive of this diagnosis as they are for Phyllodes Tumor.
